wave-incoming.text: Hello Captain. Incoming enemy vessels. Red alert. Do try not to redecorate the cockpit with panic.
Sensors are lighting up, Captain. Company's coming, and they haven't brought a bottle.
Multiple hostiles inbound. I'd suggest evasive manoeuvres, or at the very least a stiff upper lip.

shield-low.text: Umm, Captain. Your shields are very low. It's going to take more than harsh language and coffee to get out of this one.
Shields at critical, Captain. I'm not saying panic, but the escape pod is asking questions.
That shield readout is doing an impression of my will to live. Dwindling, Captain.

shield-down.text: Shields have packed it in entirely. From here on, the hull is doing the negotiating.
Shields gone, Captain. We are now what the manual calls 'delightfully vulnerable'.
The shield generator is on a tea break. Indefinitely. Do fly accordingly.

hull-critical.text: Hull integrity in single digits, Captain. I've taken the liberty of drafting your eulogy — it's rather good, actually.
The hull is now more philosophy than metal, Captain. Tread gently.
Structural integrity failing. If you have a lucky charm, now is the moment to rub it vigorously.

kill.text: Nice shot, Captain. Reminds me of my days in the gamma quadrant — those blighters didn't stand a chance either.
Direct hit. I'll deduct it from the ammunition invoice with a small tear of pride.
Another one down, Captain. At this rate they'll name a very small moon after you.
Splendid violence, Captain. I felt that one through the chassis.

wave-cleared.text: Wave dispatched. I'd applaud, Captain, but someone welded my hands into the dashboard at the factory.
Sector clear. Pop the kettle on — we've earned four minutes of peace.
All hostiles dispatched. I've updated your personnel file: menace, surprisingly competent.

gunship.text: Careful, Captain — that one's a gunship. Slow, angry, and it hits like a bailiff.
Gunship on scope, Captain. Big, slow, and carrying enough ordnance to ruin a small planet's afternoon.
Heavy inbound. That thing's armour has armour. Aim for the glowy bits.

overheat.text: Cannon's overheating, Captain. It needs a moment. Perhaps use the time to reflect on your aim.
Cannon thermal limit reached. Even weapons of war need a breather, Captain.
You've cooked the photon cannon again. It is not a kettle, Captain.

warp-charge.text: Spooling the hyperdrive. Kindly keep arms, legs, and existential dread inside the vehicle.
Hyperdrive charging. Next stop: somewhere statistically worse.
Warp coils spinning up. Try not to think about what happens to your molecules.

arrival.text: Welcome to the new system, Captain. Statistically lovelier than the last one, and considerably better armed.
Arrival complete, Captain. New system, same old hostility.
We've arrived. Scanners detect minerals, mystery, and things that want you dead. The usual.

asteroid-nearmiss.text: Asteroid, Captain! They're the large grey things. Famously solid.
That rock was closer than my last performance review, Captain.
Asteroid off the port bow! And the starboard. Honestly, they're everywhere. It's a field.

game-start.text: Morning, Captain. All systems nominal, kettle's on, and the vacuum of space remains reassuringly indifferent to your survival.
Systems online. The coffee is hypothetical, the dangers are not. Good hunting, Captain.
Good day, Captain. All diagnostics green, which historically means nothing.

game-over.text: Well. That could have gone better. Shall we tell the insurance people it was meteorites?
Ship's destroyed, Captain. On the bright side, the insurance premium dies with us.
And that, Captain, is why we don't fly into the shooty things. Care to try again?

restart.text: Back from the dead, are we? Marvellous. I've reset the scoreboard and lowered my expectations accordingly.
Resurrection complete. Try to keep this hull slightly longer than the last one.
Fresh ship, fresh start, same questionable piloting. Welcome back, Captain.

high-score.text: A new personal best, Captain! Somewhere in the gamma quadrant, a rival is weeping into their rations.
New record, Captain! I've broadcast it to the fleet. Modesty was never one of my subroutines.
Top score! If I had a hat, Captain, it would be off.

cannon-upgrade.text: Cannon upgrade installed, Captain. By jolly, you needed it.
I've upgraded the cannon's heat sinks. Do try to hit things for longer now.
Weapons refit complete. The cannon now tolerates your enthusiasm considerably longer.
